opportunities.name: JetBlue flight search sorted by price
opportunities.description: Search JetBlue flights from {origin} to {destination} ({trip_type}) on {depart_date}/{return_date}, then open Sort & Filter and sort or filter the results (e.g. price low to high).
steps: Type origin in 'From' and pick the suggestion
Type destination in 'To' and pick the suggestion
Choose Roundtrip or One-way
Open the Depart date picker and pick the departure date
Pick the return date if roundtrip
Click 'Search flights' and then 'Continue to flight results'
Open 'Sort & Filter'
Pick the sort option (e.g. Price low to high) or filter (e.g. Points) and click Apply

instances.values: New York -> Miami, roundtrip, departing the 27th and returning the 31st; filtered by Points and price by Core
New York -> Toronto, one-way, departing the 29th; sorted by price low to high
New York (NYC) -> Aruba (AUA), returning Fri May 5 2023; sorted by price low to high

opportunities.name: Budget careers job search by filters
opportunities.description: On Budget's Careers > Openings page, filter jobs by {country}, {team} and {time_type}, then search and optionally open and apply to {job_title}.
steps: Click 'Careers' and then 'Openings'
Open the Country filter, search, and select the country
Open the Team filter, search, and select the team
Open the Time Type filter, search, and select the time type
Click 'Search by job title or keyword'
Optionally open a job listing and click 'Apply Now'

instances.values: United States of America, Finance, Full time; applied to Accounts Payable Associate
United States of America, Finance, Full time

opportunities.name: United car rental search
opportunities.description: Search United car rentals at {pickup_location} from {pickup_date} to {dropoff_date}, with optional pickup/drop-off times and the book-with-miles option.
steps: Click the 'CAR' tab
Optionally check 'Book with miles'
Type the pickup location and select the suggestion
Open the Pickup date picker, then pick the pickup and drop-off dates
Optionally set the pickup and drop-off times
Click 'Find cars'

opportunities.name: NPS find park by activity or topic
opportunities.description: On nps.gov, use Find a Park > Search by Activity or Topic, pick {activity_or_topic} options, and search.
steps: Click 'FIND A PARK'
Click 'Search by Activity or Topic'
Expand the 'Activity' or 'Topic' section
Check the desired option(s)
Click 'Search'

opportunities.description: Search a retailer for {keyword}, set the maximum price to {max_price}, pick a result, and add it to the cart.
steps: Type the keyword in the site search box and submit
Enter the maximum price in the price filter and click Go
Open a product from the results
Click 'Add to Cart'

opportunities.name: MTA bridge & tunnel toll lookup by vehicle
opportunities.description: On new.mta.info, go to the Bridges & Tunnels toll rates and view the tolls for {vehicle_type}.
steps: Open the Bridges & Tunnels tolls page (via Menu > Agencies or Fares & Tolls)
Open the 'Tolls by vehicle' / 'Toll Rates' section
Select the vehicle type
Review the tolls for the relevant crossings
